_README: Human-declared total Lagrangian per model, for models where the harness
cannot resolve one. validation_benchmark.total_lag_symbol resolves the
total by reference analysis: the term no other term refers to. When more
than one such root survives, the model never declared a single total and
the harness refuses to guess — it reports ambiguous_lagrangian_symbol and
Set a value here to declare the total. The value is passed to
UFO_generator.wl as LagName and is evaluated as Wolfram, so a sum such as
'LA+LB+LC' is valid, not only a bare symbol.
null means undeclared. See LAGRANGIAN_AMBIGUITY.md for what each model
defines and why the proposed reading is what it is. NOTHING HERE IS
APPLIED UNTIL A PHYSICIST SETS IT.
